items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2 for whole-body humanoid control and multi-robot collaboration
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2，實現人形機器人全身控制、靈巧操作與多機協作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a family of models for intelligent whole-body control of humanoids from feet to fingertips, advanced dexterity, and multi-robot teamwork. It comprises the vision-language-action model Gemini Robotics 2 (full humanoid and bi-arm control), Gemini Robotics ER 2 (embodied reasoning VLM for multi-step planning and multi-robot collaboration, available in Google AI Studio), and Gemini Robotics On-Device 2 (local VLA that adapts to new embodiments in hours).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布推出 Gemini Robotics 2 系列模型，實現人形機器人從腳到指尖的智能全身控制、高靈巧度與多機器人協作。包含先進 VLA 模型 Gemini Robotics 2（全身與雙臂控制）、具身推理模型 Gemini Robotics ER 2（多步驟規劃與多機協作，已於 Google AI Studio 開放），以及可本地運行並在數小時內適配新機體的 On-Device 2。
items_flat.analysis_en: This advances physical AI beyond tabletop tasks toward general-purpose robots usable in homes and workplaces. Key uncertainty remains real-world robustness, safety in unstructured environments, and how quickly the models generalize without extensive per-robot fine-tuning.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將實體 AI 從桌面任務推向家用與職場通用機器人。關鍵不確定性在於真實非結構化環境的穩健性、安全性，以及模型在無需大量個別微調下的泛化速度。
items_flat.quote: From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks
items_flat.quote_zh: 從腳到指尖——我們正在教導機器人智能全身控制、精細靈巧度與團隊合作，以完成廣泛的複雜任務

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% and Terra by 20%, adds Fast mode for Sol
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 大幅調降 GPT-5.6 Luna 價格 80%、Terra 20%，並為 Sol 推出 Fast 模式
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced major API price reductions for the GPT-5.6 family effective immediately: Luna drops 80% to $0.20 input / $1.20 output per million tokens, Terra drops 20% to $2 / $12. Fast mode for flagship Sol delivers up to 2.5× speed at 2× price with unchanged intelligence. The cuts reflect efficiency gains (20% lower serving costs, 15%+ better token efficiency) achieved by applying Sol to optimize its own runtime; Auto-review in ChatGPT and Codex is also upgraded to Luna for roughly 10× lower cost.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布自今日起大幅調降 GPT-5.6 系列 API 價格：Luna 降 80% 至每百萬 token $0.20/$1.20，Terra 降 20% 至 $2/$12。旗艦 Sol 新增 Fast 模式，最高 2.5 倍速度、價格 2 倍，智能不變。降價來自 Sol 自我優化帶來的服務成本降低 20% 與 token 效率提升 15% 以上；ChatGPT 與 Codex 的 Auto-review 亦升級至 Luna，成本約降 10 倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: OpenAI is passing self-optimization gains directly to users, intensifying price competition at the mid- and low-cost tiers. The change makes high-volume agentic and everyday workloads far more accessible while leaving Sol’s capability and list price unchanged; sustained impact depends on whether rivals match the new price-performance curve.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 將模型自我優化成果直接回饋用戶，強化中低階模型的價格競爭力。改變在於高流量代理與日常工作變得更可負擔，同時旗艦 Sol 能力與定價不變；持續影響取決於競爭對手是否跟進新的性價比曲線。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, we are reducing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra by 20%, and offering a faster option for GPT-5.6 Sol in the API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自今日起，我們將 GPT-5.6 Luna 價格調降 80%、Terra 調降 20%，並為 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 API 中提供更快選項。
